concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-risk-management-chargeback-guidelines-diners-discover-chargebacks]] — Adyen Diners/Discover dispute guide (webpage snapshot, 2026-09-15) for optional RFI, chargeback defense, conditional reversal, pre-arbitration, and arbitration filing.
warnings: The 40-day defense deadline has no stated starting event in the captured text; the RFI's 18-day start is worded “Request for Information's data.”

Chargeback Reversed is final only if the issuer accepts; second chargeback is final in its described path; USD 500 filing fee applies to the party losing arbitration under dispute conditions, not every chargeback.
